facts.fact: The page was published on July 20, 2025.

The article's listed reading time is 2 minutes.

facts.fact: The YouTube cookie VISITOR_PRIVACY_METADATA on this site has a duration of 6 months.

Google Ads local campaigns can display ads on Google Search, Maps, Display, and YouTube to encourage people to visit stores directly, according to the vendor's description.
facts.quote: allow you to display your ads on Google Search, Maps, Display, and YouTube to encourage people to visit your stores directly.

facts.fact: A Google Ads local campaign automates ad delivery optimized to generate directions to the store, phone calls, and physical visits measured using location data.

facts.fact: Google displays key business information (address, hours, reviews) in local campaigns by using the advertiser's Google Business Profile listings.
facts.quote: to display key information (address, hours, reviews).

facts.fact: The vendor's local campaign setup guide recommends tracking visits and conversions using Store Visit Reports.
According to the vendor, Google adjusts bids and placements automatically in local campaigns to maximize visits.
facts.quote: Google adjusts bids and placements to maximize visits.
